about_the_game:
This is a Donation DLC.

I'm making this game all by myself, please, purchase this DLC only if you want to support me even more or have any interest at the bonus content.

This donation DLC gives you access to:

  • 24 Exclusive 4K Wallpapers.

  • A Touch of Magic - Model Book Summer Collection PDF.

  • A Touch of Magic - The Bestiary PDF.

Wallpapers come in the formats 4K (3840x2160), and Full HD (1920x1080).

There are 5 main Wallpapers featuring Sam, Anthea, Angela, Cherry and Celine  + 10 Alternate Angles + 9 Nude Variants showing their best assets.

Wallpaper feature:

  • Sam dressed as a sexy cop leaning against a patrol car.

  • Anthea training at the gym.

  • Angela dressed in a skimpy lingerie showing her best assets in a luxurious setting.

  • Cherry dressed in a bunny girl outfit at a neon setting.

  • Celine as a stripper at the First Sin Nightclub.

A Touch of Magic - Model Book is a PDF with 1 Cover and 10 beautiful images featuring the characters in many bikinis that vary from nice to sexy and bold!

The Bestiary is a PDF that has the descriptions of many species set in the game world, expanding the lore for those that want to know even more. This PDF will be updated with new species as the chapters progress and new characters are introduced.
